item.title: Petition calls for online marketplaces to verify UK hallmark compliance
item.description: Retail Jeweller Petition calls for online marketplaces to verify UK hallmark compliance Jewellery consultant Jayne Bond has submitted a petition to the UK Government calling for online marketplaces to verify UK hallmark compliance before allowing sellers to list precious metal jewellery to UK consumers. Petition calls for online marketplaces to verify UK hallmark compliance Ruth Faulkner

item.title: BRC reports “hard-won” drop in retail crime
item.description: Retail Jeweller BRC reports “hard-won” drop in retail crime The BRC’s Crime Report for 2024–2025 reveals daily incidents of violence and abuse against retail workers were down by a fifth on the previous year, but remain at almost four times pre-pandemic levels. item.title: NAJ and UK Assay Offices welcome government response on hallmarking reform
item.description: Retail Jeweller NAJ and UK Assay Offices welcome government response on hallmarking reform The National Association of Jewellers and the four UK Assay Offices have welcomed correspondence from the Department for Business and Trade following their joint open letter calling for targeted reform of the Hallmarking Act 1973.
